goal: Standalone Windows patcher for the existing ROTest client, without distributing the full game or credentials
approved: Owner approved public chiniji777/rotest-patcher repository, GitHub Releases, changed-files updates, backups/recovery, start-game and graphics-setup buttons
architecture: .NET 8 WinForms self-contained Windows x64 application with a dependency-free updater core. RSA-PSS signed manifests pin HTTPS assets owned by this GitHub repository. Mutable channel pointer selects immutable versioned files.
sourceIsolation: New empty repository; do not modify FINN production or Assassin Trainer
privateSigningKey: Generated outside repository, never embedded, uploaded, logged or committed; public verifier key is embedded
filePolicy: Allow only data/, System/, SystemEN/, graphics-setup-docs/ and opensetupl.exe; reject traversal, alternate streams, reserved Windows names, case-insensitive duplicates and reparse points. The first release does not update ROTest.exe or the running patcher.
recovery: Download and verify all changed files first; retain originals and a durable transaction journal; replace files atomically; recover unfinished transactions on next start; rollback refuses to overwrite unrelated manual edits and pauses the rolled-back release.

tasks.name: Core
steps: Write failing tests for signed manifest tampering, unsafe paths, differential downloads, corrupt downloads, active game and rollback
Implement validation, staging, durable journal and recovery
Run real filesystem tests on macOS and Windows

tasks.name: Windows UI
steps: Add automatic startup update plus manual update, Start, Graphics Setup, Roll Back and folder picker
Disable conflicting actions while updating and block active game updates
Show version, progress, useful failure and recovery status; do not ask for or save game passwords
Verify UI controls and a real update/relaunch on Windows

tasks.name: Release pipeline
steps: Build payload from explicit public networking XMLs, verified skill callback fix and original OpenSetup executable/licenses
Sign exact manifest bytes; publish assets and detached public channel envelope only
Publish self-contained ZIP, source commit and hashes; install on Windows Desktop without touching game data
Post downloadable patcher in existing ROTest Discord channel and verify download hash

verificationBoundary: Core tests do not prove all game actions; preserve the existing known limitation that complete ROTest skill/action and Assassin Trainer compatibility acceptance is unfinished. Initial EXE lacks a purchased Authenticode certificate; never disable antivirus to install it.
